ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity white/grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark grey pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pigmentation is localized to the distal-lateral quadrants of both lobes (outer 30%). Low-intensity dark pigmentation dominates the central and proximal regions (inner 70%).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped indentation with an estimated convergence angle of 45 degrees; the apex is obscured by high-intensity water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged boundary with irregular peaks and valleys (amplitude approx. 5-10 pixels) distributed along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward-sweeping curves originating from the central notch and tapering toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of four circular, light-rimmed scar clusters on the mid-left lobe and three distinct circular scars on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast linear streaks; dominant vertical rake marks on the upper-right lobe and diagonal intersecting marks on the mid-to-lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of high-intensity spherical barnacle colonies attached to the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'doughnut-shaped' scar with a dark center and light rim located on the upper-mid region of the left lobe.
